title: Health & Social Care (Top-Up)
subject: Health & Social Care
summary: Complete an honours degree in health and social care in one year, with several start dates.
description: This top-up builds on your Level 5 qualification, covering health policy, leadership and person-centred care.
It is popular with people already working in care who want to progress into senior roles.
entryRequirements: An HND, Foundation Degree or Level 5 Diploma in health and social care or a related subject
